title: The New Tablets and Covenant Renewed

questions.question: What did God tell Moses to do with two new tablets of stone?
options: Cut two tablets like the first ones, and God would write on them
questions.correctAnswer: Cut two tablets like the first ones, and God would write on them
questions.explanation: Exodus 34:1 (ESV): "Cut for yourself two tablets of stone like the first, and I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets."

questions.question: What happened to Moses' face after being with God?
options: The skin of his face shone
questions.correctAnswer: The skin of his face shone
questions.explanation: Exodus 34:29 (ESV): "Moses did not know that the skin of his face shone because he had been talking with God."

questions.question: What did Moses put over his face after speaking with God?
questions.explanation: Exodus 34:33 (ESV): "When Moses had finished speaking with them, he put a veil over his face."

questions.question: How long was Moses on the mountain the second time?
questions.explanation: Exodus 34:28 (ESV): "He was there with the Lord forty days and forty nights."

questions.question: What did God proclaim about His own character?
options: Merciful and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in steadfast love
questions.correctAnswer: Merciful and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in steadfast love
questions.explanation: Exodus 34:6 (ESV): "The Lord, the Lord, a God merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abounding in steadfast love and faithfulness."

questions.question: What covenant warning did God give about the inhabitants of Canaan?
options: Do not make a covenant with them, lest it become a snare
questions.correctAnswer: Do not make a covenant with them, lest it become a snare
questions.explanation: Exodus 34:12 (ESV): "Take care, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land... lest it become a snare in your midst."

questions.question: What did God command about their altars and sacred pillars?
options: Tear down their altars, break their pillars, and cut down their Asherim
questions.correctAnswer: Tear down their altars, break their pillars, and cut down their Asherim
questions.explanation: Exodus 34:13 (ESV): "You shall tear down their altars and break their pillars and cut down their Asherim."

questions.question: What does God say about worshiping other gods?
options: The Lord, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God
questions.explanation: Exodus 34:14 (ESV): "For you shall worship no other god, for the Lord, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God."

questions.question: What three feasts are restated in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Exodus 34:18,22 (ESV): "The Feast of Unleavened Bread... the Feast of Weeks... the Feast of Ingathering."

questions.question: What promise did God make about protecting Israel's land during the feasts?
options: No one shall covet your land when you appear before the Lord three times a year
questions.correctAnswer: No one shall covet your land when you appear before the Lord three times a year
questions.explanation: Exodus 34:24 (ESV): "No one shall covet your land, when you go up to appear before the Lord your God three times in the year."

questions.question: How does God describe His steadfast love?
options: Keeping steadfast love for thousands, forgiving iniquity, transgression, and sin
questions.correctAnswer: Keeping steadfast love for thousands, forgiving iniquity, transgression, and sin
questions.explanation: Exodus 34:7 (ESV): "Keeping steadfast love for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin."

questions.question: What did Moses eat or drink during his second stay on the mountain?
options: He neither ate bread nor drank water
questions.correctAnswer: He neither ate bread nor drank water
questions.explanation: Exodus 34:28 (ESV): "He neither ate bread nor drank water."

questions.question: Who wrote on the second set of tablets?
questions.explanation: Exodus 34:28 (ESV): "And he wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the Ten Commandments."

questions.question: What did God say about His visiting of iniquity?
options: He visits the iniquity of the fathers on the children to the third and fourth generation
questions.correctAnswer: He visits the iniquity of the fathers on the children to the third and fourth generation
questions.explanation: Exodus 34:7 (ESV): "But who will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children... to the third and the fourth generation."

questions.question: What was Aaron's reaction when he first saw Moses' shining face?
options: Aaron and all the people were afraid to come near him
questions.correctAnswer: Aaron and all the people were afraid to come near him
questions.explanation: Exodus 34:30 (ESV): "Aaron and all the people of Israel saw Moses, and behold, the skin of his face shone, and they were afraid to come near him."

key_verse_text: The Lord, the Lord, a God merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abounding in steadfast love and faithfulness.
